messages.en: Fancy going to the book fair at that hall tomorrow?
Yes! I've already made a list of the books I want to buy.
I've checked the map, but I still can't find the way in.
Just follow the road behind that shop. The entrance is there.
Want to go for a walk in the park this afternoon?
Yes! See you at the entrance at five this afternoon, okay?
Has Peter arrived yet? I'm heading out now.
Yeah, he's already here, waiting inside.
